        ### Question

        ### Options

opc. Diagnostic colonoscopy in a patient with dolicocolon.
opd. Polyppectomy of polyp in descending colon of sessile morphology.

CHAIN: "Diagnostic colonoscopy in a patient with dolicocolon" -> "longer colon" -> "increased difficulty in navigation" -> "possible increased risk of perforation" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Polypectomy of polyp in descending colon of sessile morphology" -> "removal of sessile polyp" -> "risk of bleeding or perforation" -> "increased risk of major complications" -> 80%
